summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K reporting a transparency notification from Madison Avenue Partners, which crossed above the 5% voting rights threshold on June 15, 2026, holding 3,498,892 shares (5.31%) as of June 24. This is a routine regulatory filing under Belgian transparency law disclosing a passive stake crossing; no acquisition offer, board recommendation, or deal mechanics are involved. The company remains a target of the filing only insofar as it discloses the investor's stake. What to watch: the filing is purely informational; no special-situation event is triggered.
